clue.text: Native warriors quiet and mischievous

parts.note: an impi is a regiment of Zulu warriors
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A band of tribal fighters is described as both silent and full of mischief.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an impish grin is a mischievous, playful one.

clue.text: Doctrines in a single text

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
an SMS is a text message

explanation.surface: Belief systems are set out in one lone message.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: isms are distinctive doctrines or ideologies, as in socialism or Buddhism.

clue.text: In rough bars a lot of beer consumes benefit money

indicators.note: the shortened beer swallows the benefit money
most of the word for a beer, losing its last letter

parts.note: a pint is a measure of beer
a giro was the UK fortnightly unemployment benefit cheque

explanation.surface: In rough pubs, much beer swallows up the dole money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bars' looks like pubs, but means ingots of crude iron; 'In' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Crude iron from the blast furnace is cast into ingots called pigs.

clue.text: Nice toes sculpted in an artistic period

indicators.note: the letters are shaped into a new form

explanation.surface: Elegant toes carved into a statue in some period of art.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian term for the 1600s, the seventeenth century of Italian art and literature.

clue.text: Retired with honour, fault not originally with our side

indicators.note: the word for fault loses its original, opening letter

parts.note: a demerit is a fault or black mark
us is our side, as opposed to them

explanation.surface: Someone retiring with honours is oddly faulted, though not at first, by their own team.
explanation.definitionFit: An emeritus professor keeps an honorary title after stepping down from the post.

clue.text: Freedom given to win more trophies is one club's aim

definitions.text: to win more trophies is one club's aim
definitions.meaning: Man U, Manchester United football club, has a mission of winning cups

explanation.surface: A football club is granted liberty to chase more silverware.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given' links the two readings; MAN U is the common nickname of Manchester United.
explanation.definitionFit: Manumission is the formal freeing of a slave by an owner.

clue.text: Provide new equipment robber picked up

indicators.note: in a down clue, picked up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a looter is a robber

explanation.surface: A thief caught by police is given a fresh set of kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' suggests an arrest or a sound effect, but turns the word round.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to retool a factory is to fit it with fresh machinery.

clue.text: One cuts a person who easily shifts positions

definitions.meaning: a tool or person that clips hedges or hair

definitions.text: a person who easily shifts positions
definitions.meaning: a political opportunist who changes sides

explanation.definitionFit: A hedge clipper cuts; historically the word also named a politician who trims sails to the wind.

clue.text: Saddle initially I forced out of shape, small problem for horse

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of saddle
the letter I is forced out of the shape

parts.note: a triangle is a shape

explanation.surface: A saddle bent out of shape is a minor nuisance for a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I forced out of shape' looks like an anagram signal; instead I leaves TRIANGLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangles is a contagious bacterial infection of horses affecting the throat.

clue.text: Image splashed over page, one in black and white

indicators.note: letters splashed about land in a new order

explanation.surface: A picture is spread across a page in a monochrome magazine layout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is only a link: IMAGE plus P is rearranged as one pool.
explanation.definitionFit: The magpie is a bird with striking black-and-white plumage.

clue.text: More difficult for one getting married?

definitions.meaning: comparative of a knotty problem, a tricky one
read as ..., someone who ties the knot

explanation.surface: A wedding is said to be harder on one particular participant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' just joins the two readings; the question mark flags the punning second one.
explanation.definitionFit: Knotty means intricate or hard to solve; a wedding is called tying the knot.

clue.text: Fresh meat widely available in peace camp

parts.note: green means fresh or unripe
ham is a cured pork meat
common means widespread or ordinary

explanation.surface: Supplies of fresh meat are plentiful at a protest encampment.
explanation.walkthrough: GREENHAM COMMON is an RAF base in Berkshire, England, where a women's peace camp protested nuclear missiles from 1981.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the site is famous for its long-running anti-nuclear women's protest encampment.

clue.text: Out of the closet, I request to start large quantities of drink

indicators.note: out signals letters coming out of order
takes the first letter of request

explanation.surface: Someone coming out asks to begin by having lots to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of the closet' suggests coming out; 'Out' is the anagram signal for THECLOSET plus I and R.
explanation.definitionFit: Measures of liquid volume, each a hundred litres, so large amounts.

clue.text: A conceited specimen a woman may take in hand

definitions.meaning: a case, or instance, of vanity, being conceited

definitions.text: a woman may take in hand
definitions.meaning: a small bag of cosmetics carried by hand

explanation.surface: A pompous example of something is held by a woman in her hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosmetics bag carried by hand is named for vanity, while case also means an example.

clue.text: Minister's accepting debt second-hand

indicators.note: the minister's takes the debt in

parts.note: a vicar is a minister of the church, with the S
an IOU is a written acknowledgement of debt

explanation.surface: A clergyman takes on borrowings from a used-goods source.
explanation.definitionFit: Vicarious experience is felt indirectly, through another person, at one remove.

clue.text: Place to go, not in river

indicators.note: not marks the word in as removed from the place to go

parts.note: a urinal is a place to go to the toilet

explanation.surface: A spot to visit is said not to lie on a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Place to go' is a euphemism for a toilet, not a destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it flows from the Russian mountains of the same name to the Caspian Sea.

clue.text: Disease from fermented grape in which everyone's thrown up

indicators.note: the second piece sits inside the fermented letters
fermenting grape juice is worked into a new state
in a down clue, thrown up reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: everyone is all; read as everyone is

explanation.surface: An illness from sour wine leaves everybody vomiting.
explanation.walkthrough: PEGRA from 'fermented' grape, with LLA (all turned round by 'thrown up') inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Pellagra is a vitamin deficiency illness causing dermatitis and diarrhoea.

clue.text: Wretched dog barked at first and bit

parts.note: a cur is a worthless mongrel

indicators.note: takes only the opening letter of barked

explanation.surface: A mangy dog barked and then bit someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bit' looks like the dog's action, but it is the noun: a horse's mouthpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A curb is a type of bit with a chain, used to restrain a horse.

clue.text: Fixed software, logged but not right

indicators.note: the logged word is kept but without the letter for right

parts.note: recorded means logged

explanation.surface: A program bug was noted down but has not been put right.
explanation.definitionFit: To recode a program is to rewrite its code, as when fixing it.

clue.text: Four voices disputed very loud

indicators.note: letters in dispute are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A quartet of singers argued at great volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: vociferous means clamorous, shouting loudly.

clue.text: Bones found here in your ass, remarkably

indicators.note: the letters are put into a remarkable new order

explanation.surface: A cheeky remark that bones are located in a backside.
explanation.definitionFit: An ossuary is a vault or container where skeletal remains are kept.

clue.text: Attack dog's neuter after surgery

indicators.note: the dog and neuter come after surgery

parts.note: op is short for operation
dog's is dog has; a pug is a small dog
n is the grammatical abbreviation for neuter

explanation.surface: A pet is neutered following its operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neuter' looks like the vet's job, but is the grammar abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppugn is an archaic verb meaning to dispute or assail an argument.

clue.text: Young scholars have pencils, so nearly create chaos

indicators.note: create chaos tells us to throw the letters into disorder
the word create is cut short by its final letter

explanation.surface: Small children with pencils almost cause mayhem in the classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' gives CREAT; PENCILSSO plus CREAT is rearranged. A RECEPTION CLASS is the first year of primary school in England, ages four to five.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the youngest pupils in a British primary school sit in this first-year group.

clue.text: River comes to a halt in the sound

indicators.note: says the letters are entered as heard, not as written

parts.note: sticks means comes to a halt, gets stuck

explanation.surface: A river stops flowing in a narrow channel of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like a stretch of sea, but signals a word heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: in Greek myth this river of the underworld is crossed by the dead.

clue.text: Conservative element in sentries about to retire?

explanation.surface: Traditionalists are found among guards who are on the point of retiring.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the long-standing, change-resistant members of a group, from Napoleon's veteran Imperial regiments.

clue.text: Shocked by long story about time injecting heroin

indicators.note: heroin is injected into the reversed story
about turns the word for a long story round

parts.note: a saga is a long story
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: Someone is appalled by a drawn-out tale of drug injection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns SAGA into AGAS, and 'injecting' puts H inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: horrified, filled with sudden dismay.

clue.text: African-American turns east, following Europeans

indicators.note: east is placed following the Europeans
the abbreviation turns around

parts.note: Danes are Europeans from Denmark
e is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: An African-American heads east after time with some Europeans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'African-American' looks like one term, but it splits: 'African' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sudanese person is a native of Sudan, a country in north-east Africa.

clue.text: A run-through cat that can produce a scream

indicators.note: a and run go through the middle of the cat

parts.note: a lynx is a wild cat
r is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A wild cat's practice session ends in a shriek.
explanation.definitionFit: The voice box is the organ in the throat that makes vocal sounds, screams included.
